findings.text: blocking: the per-file delta gate ran 29 test files plus the boundary rerun and never ran tests/test_equilibrium_stencil_mesh.py, the suite covering nova/equilibrium/stencil_mesh.py, one of the four production modules this node changed (_polygon_monomial_integral deleted at nova/equilibrium/stencil_mesh.py:573). `grep -c stencil head-gate-perfile.log base-gate-perfile.log` returns 0 for both arms, and the fragment's verification table (docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/code-hygiene.html:96) lists no stencil row. done_when (6) requires 'the suites covering every touched module pass by delta against the base' and explicitly names 'the two stencil_mesh failures that fail identically at base'; the manifest records no stencil failure at all. The deletion is verifiably safe (grep for _polygon_monomial_integral over nova/ tests/ benchmarks/ scripts/ returns nothing outside prose), so the gap is evidentiary rather than a code defect, but the node's own quantitative gate clause is unmet for one of its four touched modules.

follow-on: done_when (5) required every inspect.getsource assertion to be 'replaced by a behavioural test of the same guarantee, or deleted where the structure it guarded no longer exists'; this node deleted roughly ten such guards over production structures that still exist, with no behavioural replacement. Deleted outright: test_launchers_leave_declared_defaults_to_the_public_seam and test_production_routes_call_no_private_solver_kernel (tests/test_default_wiring.py:258,283), test_topology_read_routes_connectivity_through_the_shared_component_kernel (tests/test_topology_domain_partition.py:99), test_forward_operator_supplies_the_typed_census_saddle_to_the_clip (tests/test_xpoint_cell_wedge_clip.py:78), test_solve_paths_do_not_route_on_the_common_sol_label (tests/test_sol_support_selection.py:190), test_topology_replay_emits_the_request_policy_block (tests/test_route_solve_requests.py:218), test_scoring_uses_gradient_reference_x_and_margin_classification (tests/imas/test_diiid_forward_gs_match.py:255) and test_residual_support_has_no_boundary_flux_partition (tests/test_forward_operator_domain.py:53). The fragment asserts 'no behavioural assertion was removed', which is true of the removed lines being source-text checks, but the structural guarantees those checks carried (launcher default discipline, private-kernel avoidance, common-SOL routing, saddle-vertex supply) are now unguarded. Each is a small node to rewrite behaviourally; none holds this hygiene deletion.

follow-on: the reroute of scripts/prototypes/support/geometry.py:63 from the deleted _area_moments to separatrix_clip._centred_degree_two_moments has no gate coverage at all: no file under scripts/prototypes/support was run in either arm (the fragment's table covers tests/ only), and this reroute changes the summation order for the packed ring moments (per-ring math.fsum closed forms replaced by one vectorised owner call, then re-signed by the ring orientation at geometry.py:72). The consumer chain scripts/prototypes/support/measure.py:33, book.py:25 and guard.py:18 imports geometry, so the change is reachable script code; a single fixture-building run on the base and head trees would close it.
